_about: The school day prototypes (proto-school, 2 Nov 2026; build/reports/designs/wake-up-clock.md, school-day.md, do-it-engine.md B1): the words and lines the four school games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.

ph-eleven.src: the hours 11 and 12 (wake-up-clock.md §1): to record with Mum's number round

ph-girl-cousin.src: the girl cousin (do-it-engine.md B1: a placeholder name, not decided)

ph-boy-cousin.src: the boy cousin (do-it-engine.md B1: a placeholder name, not decided)

clock-guide.e: Wake them up at their time.

clock-head.e: Tomorrow is school! Who wakes up when?

clock-morning.e: Good morning! The bus comes at eight.

bag-guide.e: Put in the bag what Nani says.

bag-head.e: School today! Let's pack your bag.

board-head.e: Good morning! Come, you're my helper today.
